'''2005 Ohio State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Ohio (23 April 2005).<ref name="pc-events05">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050828001521/http://swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2004/2005 Events: SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing (updated 27 June 2005)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 28 August 2005.</ref> [[Nate Meeker]] won the Day 2 bye.<ref name="pc-events05" /> It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Ohio
* '''Dates:''' 23 April 2005<ref name="pc-events05" />
